title: Geologic map of the Edisto Island quadrangle, Charleston and Colleton Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2003, Geologic map of the Edisto Island quadrangle, Charleston and Colleton Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-20, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face scattered. Symbols printed below their descriptions (QHfw, QHsm, QHs, QHf, QHebr, QPsbs, QPsbem, QPsbe, QPpam, QPpae) recorded as inferred from placement; stray symbol lines near the beach sands and point bar descriptions not used. Three thicknesses print '|' for a digit (read as 1, review). Legend-only items (contact, drill holes) not recorded. No water-quality or rock-test tables on the sheet.
SUBSURFACE: section A-A' (p.1) with FEET scale (20 to -40), SEA LEVEL datum, vertical exaggeration 100; legible unit labels QPsbe, QPpae, QPsbem, QPpam (Miocene deposits are shown only on the section); unit positions/elevations and end locations not legible. Terrace margin elevations stored as contacts (Holocene <10; Silver Bluff >6/<10; Princess Anne >12/<18 ft). Map vertical datum not stated (horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 5 feet; base map 1972). SCGS drill-hole logs on file at SCGS, not included.
